title: Please list the superhero names of all the superheroes that have blue eyes
question:
Please list the superhero names of all the superheroes that have blue eyes and blond hair.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: blue eyes refers to colour = 'Blue' and eye_colour_id = colour.id; blond hair refers to colour = 'Blond' and hair_colour_id = colour.id; super power of "Agility" refers to power_name = 'Agility'

prediction.sql:
SELECT s.XCL_019
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN colour AS c_eyes ON s.XCL_022 = c_eyes.XCL_005
JOIN colour AS c_hair ON s.XCL_023 = c_hair.XCL_005
WHERE c_eyes.XCL_006 = 'Blue'
  AND c_hair.XCL_006 = 'Blond'
